Subject: Re: DPA redlines (initial) / MAP alignment

Tom / Claire / Team —

Thanks for the redlines. Technical summary and proposed mitigations:

- Retention: we can scope audit log retention to token-level metadata; full payload retention for logs is opt‑in. Proposed compromise: 90 days by default, with a 7‑year archival pathway via a signed addendum for regulated customers (requires product ops review).
- KMS: customer-managed keys (BYOK) are supported for Private deployments (VPC/on‑prem). For hosted accounts we offer a vendor KMS with HSM-backed encryption; we can propose a dual‑path in the DPA where EU workloads require BYOK and US staging uses Redwood KMS.
- Subprocessors: we provide a 30‑day change notice for major subprocessors; can include a quarterly attestations checkbox in the order form.

Timeline ask: if MedTech can accept the BYOK constraint for EU in the MAP (i.e., Private deployment for EU PII), we can meet the Week 2 sign target. If full BYOK for hosted is required across regions, that extends the timeline by ~3 weeks.

Aisha — I’ve attached a short tech note (MSA_redlines_v3.pdf) with the proposed DPA language snippets you can share. Marissa — can you confirm the legal owner for final MSA sign (your team or central legal)?

Karthik Iyer
Dir, Applied ML & Security Integrations, Redwood Inference

--
